findings.en: Show or hide conversations; 'focus' keys the list
findings.problem: Previous finding m3, still open: the round-1 suggestion was applied verbatim and «клавиши к списку» is still not Russian — keys do not go «к списку». The calque of “keys the list” survives, so the row reads as a caption (“keys to the list”) instead of an action (“focus puts the keyboard on the list”). The quote half is fixed (ёлочки), the idiom half is not.

findings.en: List agents, switch an agent's class, or speak to this session as one
findings.current: Показать агентов, сменить класс, написать как агент
findings.problem: The third clause lost its addressee. “speak to this session as one” became «написать как агент» = “write as an agent” with no object, so a reader cannot tell who is addressed; «как агент» alone also leans to the sender side (“in the capacity of an agent”) rather than “address this session in agent form”. The row is exactly at 51 cells, so the addressee has to be paid for elsewhere — the noun frame buys it.
findings.suggestion: Агенты: сменить класс, написать сессии как агент

findings.en: Switch model; /model default saves it for new sessions
findings.current: Сменить модель; /model default сохранит для новых
findings.problem: A defect the round-1 fix introduced: the verb is back but its object's noun is gone. «для новых» has no antecedent anywhere in the string — the row never says «сессии» — so a ru reader stops at “saves for new …”. «Запомнит» plus the full «для новых сессий» fits once «Сменить» is spent on the noun frame.
findings.suggestion: Модель; /model default запомнит для новых сессий

findings.en: Branch this chat; --switch here, --window elsewhere; <message> starts work
findings.problem: M1 is fixed on the bytes: <message> is back, both flags are kept, and the order now leads with the message. The committed value was 48 cells («Ответвить чат; --switch здесь, --window отдельно»); this value is 67, against the 51-cell column, so the picker paints «Ответвить чат; <message> — старт; --switch здесь,…» and `--window` plus its «отдельно» gloss never reach that surface (the /help line still shows the whole string). That is the commit's own accepted over-budget class — the tail is branching flags, as fr/vi /fork 81 and en 74 — and I could not build a form keeping both flags, both glosses and <message> under 51 (best tried: 64). Honest options: record the exception, or mirror en's order so the cut costs the message hint rather than a flag name.
findings.suggestion: Record the exception (as fr/vi) OR reorder to «Ответвить чат; --switch здесь, --window отдельно; <message> — старт» (same 67 cells) so the picker cut costs the message hint, not a flag name.

findings.en: End this session, another by name/pid, or all — /resume reopens it
findings.current: Завершить эту, другую (имя/pid) или все; /resume вернёт
findings.problem: m5's addressing fix is in («эту», «(имя/pid)»), but two things came with it: «вернёт» was stripped of its object («её») and the line is still 4 cells over, so at 51 the picker paints «…; /resume в…» — a mid-word cut that hides the reopen hint entirely. The cells saved by dropping «её» bought no compliance.
findings.suggestion: Завершить эту/другую (имя/pid)/все; /resume вернёт (uses the catalogue's own slash-list convention; keeps all three cases, «имя/pid» and the full hint) — or keep the comma form «Завершить эту, другую (имя/pid), все; /resume вернёт» (52) and record a 1-cell exception.

findings.en: Show or set tool approval mode for this session · Show or set reasoning effort (shift+tab cycles) · Open Hub links — per-link subscribe and auto-push policy · List MCP servers; add/remove one, or manage an OAuth grant
findings.current: Режим одобрения инструментов сессии: показать/задать (52) · Показать/задать усилие рассуждений; shift+tab — цикл (52) · Открыть связи с хабом: подписка и auto-push у каждой (52) · Серверы MCP: add/remove или управлять доступом OAuth (52)
findings.problem: Four values sit one cell over the column, so at 51 the picker paints 50 cells plus «…» and cuts the last word mid-way rather than dropping a clause: «…показать/зада…», «…shift+tab — ци…», «…auto-push у кажд…», «…управлять доступом OAu…». All four are content-complete; the overrun is one cell each and two have a clean one-cell shave.
findings.suggestion: hub → «Открыть связи с хабом: подписка, auto-push у каждой» (51, «и»→comma); mcp → «Серверы MCP: add/remove или управлять OAuth» (43); approvals and effort need a word dropped (approvals: drop «сессии» → 45; effort: «Показать/задать»→«Задать» → 43) or a one-cell exception recorded.

findings.en: Unread completions; read marks them read
findings.problem: Previous finding n5, only half fixed: the verb is back, its complement is not — «read помечает» marks … what? The result state (“as read”) is the thing the row exists to state. Full form is 60 cells; the complete predicate fits only if the noun goes: «Непрочитанные; read помечает прочитанными» (41).

findings.en: Cancel, retry or steer the highlights under an answer
findings.problem: “under an answer” — the location that identifies which block this acts on — is dropped; «дополнения» is also the word the settings page uses for supplements, so without the location the row leans on that collision. The verb triad is accurate.
findings.suggestion: Отменить, повторить или скорректировать дополнения под ответом
findings.suggestion_note: 62 cells — does not fit 51; recorded as a known tradeoff, not as an acceptance that fits.

findings.en: Track workstreams: list, show, new, delete, link, unlink
findings.current: Вести потоки: list, show, new, delete, link, unlink
findings.problem: «потоки» bare drops the qualified term the catalogue already established («рабочие потоки», wire.settings.session_cleanup). «Рабочие потоки: …» is 53 (over); the fitting 51-cell form, «Потоки работ: …», is a third variant of the same term.
findings.suggestion: Потоки работ: list, show, new, delete, link, unlink

findings.problem: «Цикл к цели» is a calque; Russian pairs the noun with «до», not «к», for this sense. One preposition fixes it inside budget.

findings.en: Configure web search providers and load balancing
findings.problem: Previous n4 is fixed («нагрузки» restored), but the noun frame drops “Configure”, so the row reads like a read-only status view of a command that edits settings. The verb form is 56 cells; the frames used elsewhere (/context, /mcp, /network) make this consistent, which is why it is a NIT and not a defect.
findings.suggestion: Настроить провайдеров веб-поиска и балансировку нагрузки
findings.suggestion_note: 56 cells — over budget; recorded as the tradeoff behind the noun frame.
